label: Media gallery
purpose: Show a set of images/videos as a browsable grid or carousel, with a lightbox for the full view.
when_to_use: A photo/video collection on a profile or post — a gallery, an album, an attachment strip.
when_not_to_use: A single hero image (render it inline) or a data-heavy chart set (use the charts blocks).
composition: Grid/strip — thumbnails in a responsive grid, or a Carousel on narrow widths; each thumbnail a Card with the media (or the placeholder surface when not loaded)
Lightbox — a Dialog that opens the selected item full-size, with prev/next ghost Buttons
Empty — the Empty component when the gallery has no items
primary_action: None at rest; inside the lightbox the close and prev/next are ghost/outline. No filled primary competes with the app's.
responsive: A multi-column grid at md+; a single-item Carousel below md. Thumbnails keep a fixed aspect ratio (aspect-square/aspect-video) and never overflow the row.
accessibility: every thumbnail has descriptive alt text; a placeholder uses role=img + aria-label
the lightbox Dialog traps and restores focus; prev/next are keyboard operable
any caption over media sits on a scrim, never directly on the image
content: Ships the sanctioned media placeholders (a muted surface + a lucide icon) where no real image exists — never an invented stock photo.
anti_patterns: embedding invented stock imagery instead of the docs/placeholders.md media slot
text laid directly over an image with no scrim
a filled primary Button inside the gallery competing with the page's primary
assumptions: Media are PLACEHOLDER slots — wire real images/videos, and use docs/placeholders.md where none exist.
The lightbox is a Dialog; swap for a route if deep-linking to an item is required.
Grid density (columns) is a starting point — tune to the real media count.

references.note: shadcn ships no gallery block (canonical blocks are dashboard, sidebar, login, signup — https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks). Composed from shadcn PRIMITIVES (Card, Carousel, Dialog, Button, Empty); every part a real, in-repo component.
